name: @langfuse/native
description: Rust native addon (napi-rs) loaded by the Langfuse worker

scripts.lint: pnpm run prepare-clickhouse-source && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run prepare-clickhouse-source && cargo fmt && cargo clippy --all-targets --fix --allow-dirty -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm run prepare-clickhouse-source && pnpm --filter worker run export-native-codec-fixtures -- packages/native/target/native-codec-fixtures.json && LANGFUSE_NATIVE_NORMALIZED_FIXTURES=target/native-codec-fixtures.json LANGFUSE_NATIVE_NORMALIZED_FIXTURES_REQUIRED=1 cargo test --locked
